name: Admin Document Delete
description: Admin deletes a document from the actions sheet: 'Eliminar' opens ConfirmModal; confirming sends DELETE /api/documents/:id/delete/ and removes the row/card; cancelling keeps it. Current list spec only asserts the button is visible.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): happy path + cancel/error branches over mocked API.
